news.title_en: Eliyan raises $145 million at $1 billion valuation to ease AI chip data bottlenecks
news.title_zh: Eliyan raises $145 million at $1 billion valuation to ease AI chip data bottlenecks
news.summary_en: Eliyan, a startup that aims to ease the bottlenecks in transferring data between AI chips in data centers, ‌said on Wednesday it had raised $145 million in venture funding at a $1 billion ‌valuation.  Cisco Systems, Lumentum and an early investor in networking pioneer Mellanox before its sale to Nvidia backed the raising, ​according to Santa Clara, California-based Eliyan.  The startup is developing technology aimed at the growing list of companies that are developing their own custom AI computing chips to compete with graphics processing units from Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices.

news.title_en: Hyperscaler debt binge pushes yields up as investor demand cools
news.title_zh: Hyperscaler debt binge pushes yields up as investor demand cools
news.summary_en: Major U.S. technology companies are borrowing heavily as they ramp up spending on their artificial intelligence buildout, and at steadily higher yields as investors become more selective about absorbing the growing supply.  Amazon, Alphabet, Meta Platforms and Oracle issued about $194 ‌billion of bonds in 2026 through July 7, up 79% from roughly $108 billion in all of 2025, according to a Reuters analysis ‌of LSEG data.  Goldman Sachs expects bond issuance by the five hyperscalers, including Microsoft Corp, to reach roughly $250 billion this year and $400 billion in 2027.
